Title: IChatMessageService - Chat History Manager
Summary: Maintains chat history with separate kernel and display histories. Supports streaming tokens, persistence, and role-based routing. Kernel-locked (one per chat).
Content:
## IChatMessageService

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Maintains chat history. Marked as "Kernel locked" - one instance per kernel/chat.

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `KernelHistory` | `IReadOnlyList<ChatMessageContent>` | All messages sent to the LLM (user, assistant, system, tool) |
| `DisplayHistory` | `IReadOnlyList<ChatMessageContent>` | Only messages displayed to the user |
| `Options` | `ChatOptions` | Role configuration |

### Methods

#### OnStreamToken(Action<string?> callback)
Subscribe to streaming tokens. Returns `IDisposable` for unsubscribing.

#### OnDisplayHistoryChanged(Action<ChatHistory> callback)
Subscribe to display history changes.

#### OnKernelHistoryChanged(Action<ChatHistory> callback)
Subscribe to kernel history changes.

#### OnHistoryLoaded(Action<ChatHistory> callback)
Subscribe to history loaded event.

#### GetKernelHistory()
Gets the full kernel history including system prompts from `IPromptManager`.

#### LoadHistory(IEnumerable<ChatMessageContent> kernelHistory, IEnumerable<ChatMessageContent>? displayHistory)
Manually loads history into memory.

#### LoadHistoryAsync()
Loads history from the persistence store.

#### AddMessage(ChatMessageContent content)
Adds a message. Automatically routes to kernel and/or display history based on role.

#### AddMessage(AuthorRole role, string? content)
Adds a message with the given role.

#### AddMessage(AuthorRole role, string? input, params AdditionalMessageContent[] items)
Adds a message with additional content items.

#### ClearHistoryAsync()
Removes persisted messages and clears in-memory history.

#### Stream(string? token)
Streams a token to subscribers.

### Extension Methods (ChatMessageServiceExtensions)
- `LogInfo(string? message)` - Add LogInfo message
- `LogSuccess(string? message)` - Add LogSuccess message
- `LogWarn(string? message)` - Add LogWarn message
- `LogError(string? message)` - Add LogError message
- `AddSystemMessage(string? message)` - Add system message
- `AddAssistantMessage(string? message)` - Add assistant message
- `AddUserMessage(string? message)` - Add user message
- `AddToolMessage(string? message)` - Add tool message

- `ChatMessageService` - Implementation
- `ChatOptions` - Role configuration

- `AdditionalMessageContent` - Extra message content
